prompts.foxtailSprite:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent pixel-art vehicle sprite atlas for the original game FOXTAIL GARAGE.
Create ONE square PNG sheet containing EXACTLY THREE separate top-down overhead vehicle sprites, arranged in three widely separated horizontal rows. Every vehicle faces RIGHT; camera exactly vertically overhead, with flat roof visible, no perspective or isometric angle, no visible side wall.
TOP ROW: a charming cream and coral vintage campervan, brown luggage case and small cream star on roof, blue-green front windscreen at the RIGHT end, short dark wheels protrude top and bottom. Body approximately 2.2 times as long as wide.
MIDDLE ROW: a rich honey-gold compact car, blue-green glass front windscreen at RIGHT, back glass on left, warm body bevels, dark wheels. Body approximately 2.2 times as long as wide.
BOTTOM ROW: a long dusty-blue delivery van, pale-blue ribbed cargo roof and rich teal glass at RIGHT end, dark wheels. Body approximately 3.4 times as long as wide.
Each sprite sits horizontally centered, within its own one-third vertical band, with plentiful clean TRANSPARENT space between all sprites. Use beautiful precise hand-placed-looking chunky pixel clusters, crisp edges, no antialiasing, cream specular edge pixels, dark navy outlines, moderate saturated autumn colours; match a premium cosy pixel workshop game. The total opaque extent of each sprite is at most 82% sheet width. Body and wheels stay together; no floating details. Controlled one-pixel highlights and 3-4 shade ramps, clean silhouette readable at 66x30 or 102x30 pixels. Neutral consistent top-left light. Transparent outside the three vehicles, NO background, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no extra vehicles, no decorative sheet borders.
prompts.foxtailMaple:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ultra-wide 3:1 environment banner, actual in-game scenery for FOXTAIL GARAGE.
Draw an exquisite cosy pixel-art GARAGE WORKSHOP frontage in a very wide landscape 3:1 aspect ratio. Straight-on front elevation, miniature dollhouse scale, no diagonal isometric camera. The entire banner is the building and a very narrow forecourt strip. Brick cream sandstone workshop fills most of frame, dark deep teal roof and painted wooden framing. In the centre a wide OPEN dark garage door with amber lights, organised hanging spanners, little tool cabinet and wooden counter visible inside. Two broad golden glowing window groups on either side. Modest tyre stacks and a terracotta pot with greenery at far edges, trailing ivy and restrained soft leaves. Space at top centre for an empty wooden hanging sign with NO lettering. Premium intricate hand-authored pixel-art quality, clean pixel clusters, believable layered depth without blurred lighting; richly contrasting warm amber windows and cool petrol teal shadows, coral and honey accent details, creamy highlights. Fine masonry, roof tile and metalwork detail grouped into coherent readable shapes. Main value focus amber centre. No cars, no people, no road markings, no parked objects covering the doorway. No text, letters, UI, HUD, logos, watermarks, or decorative frame. Full bleed opaque image. Not a painting, not a photo, not a blurry 3D render. Broad composition remains readable as a 288x86 game banner.
